english.notes:
(i) The penalty for this offence increased from 1st August 2022; for offences committed before that date see H4504.
(ii) Land includes public road, highway or path and openings from such land (Night Poaching Act 1844).
(iii) Section 1 makes no mention of a dog however section 30 of the Game Act 1831 - trespassing by day - is not so limited.
(iv) See section 2 of the Poaching Prevention Act 1862 for the police power to stop and search persons or conveyance coming from land and seize any game or guns etc.
(v) See section 2(1) of the Game Laws (Amendment) Act 1960 for the power of entry by the police for the purpose of arresting offenders.
(vi) See section 4 of the Game Laws (Amendment) Act 1960 for the police power of search and seizure of game, guns and devices.
(vii) See section 2 for the power of land owner etc to apprehend offenders and deliver to police.
(viii) Section 65 of the Police, Crime, Sentencing and Courts Act 2022 provides for recovery orders on conviction of an offence under this section.
(ix) Where a dog was used in or was present at the commission of this offence, see section 66 for disqualification orders.

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 51 weeks imprisonment and/or a fine.

In relation to an offence committed before the coming into force of section 281(5) of the Criminal Justice Act 2003, the reference to 51 weeks is to be read as a reference to 6 months.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
